description:
`repository_state` re-exports items twice under opposite `cfg` conditions, and holds an uncalled scaffold and a test-only membership-diff function.

## Background

- `crates/jit/src/repository_state/mod.rs` holds `cfg` re-export twins at `:34-51` (membership diff), `:80-99` (capture closure) and `:214-230` (`serialize_ruleset`, `SchemaFile`, `SerializedRuleSet`). Consumers include `commands/validate.rs` and the integration tests `tests/fast_rules/derived_state_repair_tests.rs:3,147`. Public items in a public module raise no unused lint, so an unconditional `pub use` serves both.
- `neutral_files` (`repository_state/initialize.rs:325-344`) has no caller.
- `default_rule_membership_diff` (`repository_state/default_rules.rs:404-421`, `allow(dead_code)`) and `DefaultRuleMembershipDiff::is_empty` (`:336-344`) are called only by their own tests and a doctest. Production uses `default_rule_membership_diff_from_identities` (`:434`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `repository_state/mod.rs` re-exports each item once, unconditionally, with no twin under opposite `test` or `test-support` conditions.
- [hard] REQ-02: `neutral_files`, `default_rule_membership_diff` and `DefaultRuleMembershipDiff::is_empty` no longer exist.
- [hard] REQ-03: No public item in `repository_state/` carries `allow(dead_code)`.

## Notes

The `pub(crate)` allows at `repository_state/index.rs:100,118` mark code that is live in other build configurations, and they stay.
title: Remove cfg twins in repository_state
